overview_description.description: Cashee is a digital banking and financial education platform designed for children and teenagers aged 6–18. Powered by Arab National Bank (anb) in Saudi Arabia, the platform provides prepaid Visa cards and a mobile app that enables young users to spend, save, earn, and track money responsibly. Cashee combines financial literacy with gamified experiences, allowing users to set savings goals, complete educational challenges, receive pocket money digitally, and monitor spending in real time. Parents can oversee transactions, manage allowances, and encourage healthy financial habits through built-in controls and analytics, making Cashee a modern family-focused fintech solution for youth banking and money management.
